title: sieve_admin.rs: replace compile() with daemon POST /check
description:
Replace the local usenet_ipfs_sieve::compile() call in the admin API with a daemon check call.

What: crates/smtp/src/sieve_admin.rs

Algorithm:
1. In the PUT /admin/sieve/{user}/{name} handler: replace usenet_ipfs_sieve::compile(&bytes) with sieve_client::check_via_daemon(&config.delivery.sieve_daemon, &bytes).await.
2. In POST /admin/sieve/check handler: same replacement.
3. If daemon is disabled (socket_path empty): return 503 Service Unavailable with body 'sieve daemon not configured; cannot validate scripts'.
4. If daemon returns Err(Unreachable): return 503 'sieve daemon unreachable'.
5. If daemon returns Err(compile error string): return 422 Unprocessable Entity with the error string (unchanged behaviour from today).
6. Remove all remaining use usenet_ipfs_sieve imports from sieve_admin.rs.

Defensive rules:
- Do not change the 422 error format; callers depend on it.
- 503 is the correct code for 'dependency unavailable'; do not use 500.
